s1.syndrome_frame: Progressive orbital syndrome with cranial nerve involvement
salient_findings: Left proptosis with resistance to globe retropulsion
Forehead anesthesia in the V1 division of the trigeminal nerve
key_facts: 2-month history of diplopia and pain
Recurring forehead lesion first excised 6 years prior to presentation
Initial histopathologic findings showed a Breslow thickness of 6 mm
Extensive perineural and intraneural invasion
Lesion recurred twice
Visual acuity was 20/20 bilaterally without afferent pupillary defect
Left upper eyelid edema, erythema, and ptosis
Adduction was limited on the left with associated strabismus
MRI finding: Left superior orbit mass extending along the supraorbital nerve to the cavernous sinus
Frontal nerve biopsy showed malignant cells with mitotic activity

shortlist.label: Malignant melanoma
shortlist.why_kept: Histopathologic findings and biopsy results consistent with melanoma

shortlist.label: Perineural spread of skin cancer
shortlist.why_kept: Extensive perineural and intraneural invasion, consistent with perineural spread

shortlist.label: Desmoplastic melanoma
shortlist.why_kept: Recurring forehead lesion and histopathologic findings suggestive of desmoplastic melanoma

shortlist.label: Malignant peripheral nerve sheath tumor
shortlist.why_kept: Frontal nerve biopsy showing malignant cells with mitotic activity, consistent with MPNST

shortlist.label: Trigeminal schwannoma
shortlist.why_kept: MRI finding of left superior orbit mass extending along the supraorbital nerve to the cavernous sinus, consistent with trigeminal schwannoma

raw.rationale: The patient's history of a recurring forehead lesion with initial histopathologic findings of a Breslow thickness of 6 mm and extensive perineural and intraneural invasion, combined with the MRI finding of a left superior orbit mass extending along the supraorbital nerve to the cavernous sinus and the frontal nerve biopsy showing malignant cells with mitotic activity, strongly supports perineural spread of skin cancer, specifically from the initial melanoma.

rejected.label: Malignant melanoma
rejected.why: While the patient has a history of melanoma, the current presentation is more indicative of spread rather than a new primary melanoma.

rejected.label: Desmoplastic melanoma
rejected.why: There is no specific mention of desmoplastic features in the histopathology, making this less likely.

rejected.label: Malignant peripheral nerve sheath tumor
rejected.why: The biopsy shows malignant cells consistent with melanoma, not typical of malignant peripheral nerve sheath tumors.

rejected.label: Trigeminal schwannoma
rejected.why: The presence of malignant cells with mitotic activity and the history of melanoma make schwannoma, a typically benign tumor, unlikely.
